critique_summary: The fleet is experiencing significant cross-bot correlation in crypto shorts and a critical logic failure in the Navigator bot, which has doubled its allowed position limit. Kraken performance is degraded by high-drawdown outliers like NEAR (-4.27%) and RENDER (-20.75% fleet-wide), suggesting stop-loss parameters are failing to contain volatility-induced slippage.

Extreme underperformance in RENDER/USD (16.7% win rate, -20.75% P&L)
Divergence in Navigator win rate (11.1%) vs expected swing performance
High correlation risk: multiple bots holding identical short positions in SEI and LINK
